contributions.detail: p2 Form A is entirely blank at 200 dpi (the faint marks are reverse-side bleed-through, identical in pattern to the other blank Carr scans in this chunk). The filer filled ONLY the CUMULATIVE column, writing '.00' on all four lines; the LAST-REPORT and THIS-REPORT columns are left blank on every line. Rows sum 0.00 and cover line 1 cumulative is .00 -> exact. Scope is cumulative because the cumulative cell is the only printed figure on the line. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: p3 Form B is entirely blank at 200 dpi. Cover line 3 cumulative reads '.00' -> exact against zero rows.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr form prints no page subtotal and no schedule total on either p2 or p3; the cover's own lines are the only anchors, and both close.
gates.row_count: Not run against a grid: neither p2 nor p3 carries any filer ink, so there is no row to score. Verified by reading both pages full-page at 200 dpi.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable — zero rows emitted on both sides.
gates.balance_chain: Closes trivially: 0 + 0 - 0 = 0, and cover line 4 cumulative reads '.00'. A genuine nil report.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crop of the CUMULATIVE column, lines 1-4 (x=3350 y=3720 W=1400 H=1750). All four cells render as a decimal point followed by two hand-drawn zeros — '.00' — with nothing to the left of the point. This confirms the value is zero dollars and zero cents, not a truncated figure.
notes: index.csv says candidate=Lemon, office='County Executive', 2014. THE FORM SAYS MORE THAN THE INDEX: 'Name of Office: EXECUTIVE/SURVEYOR' — the filer named TWO offices on one line.
